# textexture — Stylized Text Image Generator

- purpose: Generate PNG images with decorative text effects (shadow, outline, gradient, glow, neon)
- version: 0.2.0
- language: Rust
- rendering: tiny-skia (vector rasterizer) + cosmic-text (text shaping)
- max-canvas: 1920x1920px
- auto-fit: font size shrinks to fit width constraint, min 8px

## Command Syntax

```
textexture [--json] render <TEXT> [OPTIONS]
textexture [--json] bmfont <CHARS> [OPTIONS]
textexture [--json] list-effects
textexture [--json] list-fonts [--search <QUERY>]
```

## Render Arguments

- `<TEXT>`: Text to render (positional, required)
- `-o, --output <PATH>`: Output file (default: textexture_output.png)
- `-f, --font <NAME|PATH>`: Font family name or .ttf/.otf path
- `-s, --font-size <PX>`: Font size in pixels (default: 72, auto-shrinks to fit width)
- `-c, --color <CSS>`: Text color (default: #ffffff)
- `--bg <SPEC>`: Background — solid "#ff0000", gradient "#ff0000,#0000ff", multi-gradient "#r,#g,#b@45", or image path "./bg.jpg" (default: #000000)
- `--transparent`: Transparent background (overrides --bg)
- `-W, --width <PX>`: Image width, max 1920 (auto if omitted)
- `-H, --height <PX>`: Image height, max 1920 (auto if omitted)
- `--padding <PX>`: Padding around text (default: 40)
- `-e, --effect <SPEC>`: Effect, repeatable. Format: name:key=val,key=val
- `--json`: One JSON envelope on stdout; render data = {output, width, height}

## Background Modes

- Solid color: --bg "#ff0000"
- 2-color gradient: --bg "#ff0000,#0000ff"
- Multi-color gradient with angle: --bg "#ff0000,#00ff00,#0000ff@45"
- Image file: --bg ./photo.jpg (stretched to canvas)
- Transparent: --transparent

## Effects

- shadow (Pre phase): Drop shadow. Params: color(#00000080), ox(4), oy(4), blur(8)
- outline (Post phase): Text stroke. Params: color(#ffffff), width(2)
- gradient (Fill phase): Gradient text fill. Params: start(#ff0000), end(#0000ff), angle(0)
- glow (Post phase): Outer glow, Screen blend. Params: color(#00ffff), radius(15)
- neon (Post phase): 3-layer neon (outer+inner+core). Params: color(#ff00ff), radius(20)
- grain: Film/print grain on text. Params: amount, seed, scale
- Authoritative list: `textexture list-effects --json`

## BMFont Subcommand

```
textexture bmfont <CHARS> [-o <BASENAME>] [-f <FONT>] [-s <PX>] [-c <CSS>] [--padding <PX>] [-e <SPEC>]... [--json]
```

- Writes `<BASENAME>.fnt` (BMFont text format) + `<BASENAME>.png` atlas. Default basename: textexture_font
- `<CHARS>`: characters to bake (deduplicated); `--padding` per glyph cell (default 12) leaves room for effect bleed
- JSON data: {fnt, atlas, atlas_size:[w,h], glyphs, line_height, base}

## Effect Pipeline Order

1. Pre (behind text): shadow
2. Fill (replaces text color): gradient
3. Post (on top): outline, glow, neon

## Examples

```bash
textexture render "Hello" -o hello.png
textexture render "NEON" -s 120 --bg "#0a0a2e" -e "neon:color=#00ffff,radius=20" -o neon.png
textexture render "SALE" --bg "#ff6b6b,#ffd93d" -e "outline:color=#fff,width=2" -o sale.png
textexture render "RGB" --bg "#ff0000,#00ff00,#0000ff@90" -o rgb.png
textexture render "HERO" --bg ./photo.jpg -e "glow:color=#fff,radius=10" -o hero.png
textexture render "FIT" -W 300 --transparent -e "gradient:start=#e94560,end=#0f3460" -o fit.png
textexture --json render "Test" -o test.png
textexture list-effects
textexture list-fonts --search "Helvetica"
```

## Exit Codes

- 0: Success
- 1: Runtime error
- 2: Usage (bad color, unknown effect, bad effect param)
- 3: Input (font not found / not loadable, bad background image)

## Machine Call Contract (r_lit CLI contract v1)

- spec: docs/cli-contract.md (repo root); implementation: crates/rlit_cli
- json: `--json` is global; stdout carries exactly one JSON envelope, also on failure; logs go to stderr
- envelope: {"contract":1, "ok", "tool":"textexture", "version", "command", "data", "artifacts":[{"path","role","bytes","sha256"}], "error":null|{"code","kind","message"}, "warnings"?}
- exit_codes: 0 ok, 1 runtime, 2 usage, 3 input, 4 external, 5 partial (ok=false, data still complete)
- schema: `textexture __schema` prints JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) per subcommand, with x-cli (argv mapping, io role), x-effects, x-env, x-stdin, x-note
- non_interactive: never prompts
- effects: render/bmfont=local-write (reproducible when --font is a .ttf/.otf path; family names depend on installed fonts), list-effects/list-fonts=read-only
